scripts.build:linux-amd64: bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 "--define:process.env.OPENTUI_LIBC='glibc'" ./apps/pvx/src/index.ts --outfile dist/pvx && tar -czf dist/pvx-linux-amd64.tar.gz -C dist pvx && rm dist/pvx
scripts.build:linux-arm64: bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 "--define:process.env.OPENTUI_LIBC='glibc'" ./apps/pvx/src/index.ts --outfile dist/pvx && tar -czf dist/pvx-linux-arm64.tar.gz -C dist pvx && rm dist/pvx
scripts.build:darwin-arm64: bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 ./apps/pvx/src/index.ts --outfile dist/pvx && tar -czf dist/pvx-darwin-arm64.tar.gz -C dist pvx && rm dist/pvx
scripts.build:all: bun run build:linux-amd64 && bun run build:linux-arm64 && bun run build:darwin-arm64 && bun run build:windows-amd64
